acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.description: By accessing or using Ten10 (web app or desktop app), you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

eligibility.title: Eligibility & Account
eligibility.description: Use of Ten10 is subject to the following conditions:
eligibility.item1: You must be 18 years or older, or have parental/legal guardian consent
eligibility.item2: You must provide accurate information and keep it updated
eligibility.item3: Keep your login credentials secure and notify us of unauthorized access

service.title: Service Description
service.description: Ten10 is a tithe management and financial budget system. The service includes:
service.item2: Management of income, expenses, and donations

intendedUse.title: Permitted Use
intendedUse.description: Ten10 is intended for personal use only, for managing tithes and household budgeting.
intendedUse.item1: The service is not intended for commercial, business, or organizational use
intendedUse.item2: Sale, rental, or commercial distribution of the service is prohibited
intendedUse.item3: Organizational use requires a separate agreement in advance

dataAndPrivacy.title: Data, Privacy & Platform Differences
dataAndPrivacy.description: Ten10 has both a web version (cloud) and a desktop version (local). Data handling differs between them.
dataAndPrivacy.item1: Web: account data (e.g., email) and app data may be stored in our Supabase database
dataAndPrivacy.item2: Web: financial records you enter (transactions, recurring transactions) may be stored to provide the service
dataAndPrivacy.item3: Web: communication preferences (e.g., reminders, mailing consent) may be stored to respect your choices
dataAndPrivacy.item4: Support: if you contact us, we may store your message, attachments, and basic technical metadata (e.g., app version, locale, user-agent)
dataAndPrivacy.item5: Desktop: your financial data is stored locally on your device (SQLite) unless you choose to export/share it
dataAndPrivacy.item6: Web: a receipt you upload to the assistant (image or PDF) is stored privately for up to 30 days and then deleted. Deleting the file does not delete a transaction you already saved

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParties.description: To operate Ten10 we may rely on third-party services. Your use of Ten10 may involve these providers under their own terms and policies.
thirdParties.item2: AWS SES (sending service emails such as reminders and download links)
thirdParties.item3: Cloudflare (email routing and CAPTCHA verification/anti-bot measures where applicable)
thirdParties.item4: Google Analytics (landing page analytics, if enabled)

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.description: Ten10 provides a tool for managing tithes and handling financial data. However:
disclaimer.note: The system is halachically approved by the Torat Ha’adam La’adam Institute, but final halachic decisions are the user's responsibility. It is recommended to consult with a qualified rabbi for specific halachic questions.

limitations.description: Ten10 is not responsible for any direct, indirect, or consequential damages arising from the use or non-use of the service. The service is provided 'as is' without any warranty.

communications.description: By using Ten10, you agree that we may send you service-related messages.
communications.signupNotice: Consent to receive marketing updates is provided at the signup screen, where you are presented with an opt-out option, and not by these Terms.
communications.item1: Service emails (monthly reminders): Independent service emails that can be disabled in Settings. Separate from marketing preferences
communications.item2: Marketing emails (updates and news): The option to receive marketing updates is provided in the signup screen. When providing your email address, a notice is displayed that the address may also be used to send marketing updates, and you are given the option to decline. These terms alone do not serve as a substitute for this notice
communications.item3: Separate unsubscribe links: for reminders only, marketing only, or both. Do not reply to no-reply addresses; contact us via the support email instead
